title: Midrash Lekach Tov

description: Medieval commentary on the Torah incorporating literal explanations and aggadah. Complete Midrash text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Midrash is a family of rabbinic works that interpret scripture through legal exposition, narrative expansion and homily. The genre spans several centuries and several distinct collections.
